label: 根视口是 1920×1080（无头默认 64×64，不设的话控件坐标全错）
开局：标题屏那颗没有名字，按唯一可见文字点「开始游戏」
推进 10 个逻辑步（不等墙钟）
命令栏「停靠」：开出目的地弹层
选「贫城」——这一按就是 Dock 动词
等它从野地开到贫城并靠上（40 米 = 1000 步，留余量）
真的停住了
三条用途的前置条件：仓库摆 4 单位魔晶、可用法力先花掉 5 格（eval 只摆条件，被验的用途仍走界面按钮）
eval: var w = Main.World!; w.Town.ProduceCrystal(4.0); for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) w.Town.TrySpendInstantMana(); return "crystal=" + w.CrystalWarehouse + " mana=" + w.Town.AvailableMana;

label: 仓库 4 单位、可用法力 7/12
俯视甲板，点兽身开巨兽面板（走玩家那一条左键入口）
eval: var b = Main.World!.Voyage.Position; Main.CameraSetPose((float)b.X, (float)b.Z, 105f, 205f, 80f); var p = Main.Picker; string hit = ""; for (int y = 40; y < 1040 && hit == ""; y += 4) { for (int x = 40; x < 1880 && hit == ""; x += 4) { var r = p.Pick(new Godot.Vector2(x, y)); if (r.Target == DemoFactory.Prototypes.BeastArena.Ui.PickTarget.Beast) hit = x + "," + y; } } if (hit == "") throw new System.Exception("no-beast"); var parts = hit.Split(','); var mi = Main.GetType().GetMethod("OnWorldClicked", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance); mi!.Invoke(Main, new object[] { new Godot.Vector2(int.Parse(parts[0]), int.Parse(parts[1])) }); var bf = Main.GetType().GetField("_beastPanel", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance); var bp = (Godot.Control)bf!.GetValue(Main)!; if (!bp.Visible) throw new System.Exception("beast-panel-closed at " + hit); return "opened " + hit;

label: 等巨兽面板刷新
等面板重算置灰
魔晶「补魔」那一颗：这一按就是 UseCrystal(mana) 动词
补魔那一发成了
补魔真的回填 5 格、仓库扣 1 单位
eval: var w = Main.World!; if (w.Town.AvailableMana != 12 || w.CrystalWarehouse != 3) throw new System.Exception("mana=" + w.Town.AvailableMana + " wh=" + w.CrystalWarehouse); return "mana=" + w.Town.AvailableMana + " wh=" + w.CrystalWarehouse;

label: 治疗的前置条件：把 w2 打成重伤（eval 只摆条件）
eval: var u = Main.World!.Roster.Find("w2"); if (u == null) throw new System.Exception("no w2"); u.Hp = -10; u.State = DemoFactory.Prototypes.BeastArena.Logic.UnitState.Wounded; return u.StateText;

label: 等面板重摆治疗候选
魔晶「治疗」那一颗：这一按就是 UseCrystal(heal) 动词
治疗那一发成了
w2 站起来、仓库再扣 1 单位
eval: var w = Main.World!; var u = w.Roster.Find("w2")!; if (u.State != DemoFactory.Prototypes.BeastArena.Logic.UnitState.Standing || w.CrystalWarehouse != 2) throw new System.Exception("state=" + u.StateText + " wh=" + w.CrystalWarehouse); return "state=" + u.StateText + " wh=" + w.CrystalWarehouse;

label: 修理的前置条件：饭馆打掉 20 点耐久、派一名工人在岗（eval 只摆条件）
饭馆里有一名在岗工人
收起巨兽面板：右键建筑菜单要能落到世界里
俯视甲板，扫出饭馆的屏幕点，再走玩家那一条右键入口开建筑菜单
eval: var b = Main.World!.Voyage.Position; Main.CameraSetPose((float)b.X, (float)b.Z, 105f, 205f, 80f); if (!Main.World.CanRepair("restaurant")) throw new System.Exception("blocker=" + Main.World.RepairBlockerOf("restaurant")); var p = Main.Picker; string hit = ""; for (int y = 40; y < 1040 && hit == ""; y += 4) { for (int x = 40; x < 1880 && hit == ""; x += 4) { var r = p.Pick(new Godot.Vector2(x, y)); if (r.Target == DemoFactory.Prototypes.BeastArena.Ui.PickTarget.Building && r.BuildingId == "restaurant") hit = x + "," + y; } } if (hit == "") throw new System.Exception("no-restaurant"); var parts = hit.Split(','); var mi = Main.GetType().GetMethod("OnWorldRightClicked", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance); mi!.Invoke(Main, new object[] { new Godot.Vector2(int.Parse(parts[0]), int.Parse(parts[1])) }); var mf = Main.GetType().GetField("_buildingMenu", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance); var menu = (Godot.Control)mf!.GetValue(Main)!; if (!menu.Visible) throw new System.Exception("menu-closed at " + hit); return "opened " + hit;

label: 建筑菜单「修理」那一颗：开一条正在修理的活
修理那一发成了
饭馆进入「正在修理」
eval: var w = Main.World!; if (!w.Deck.IsRepairing("restaurant")) throw new System.Exception("not-repairing"); return "repairing=1";

label: 收起建筑菜单
eval: var f = Main.GetType().GetField("_buildingMenu", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance); ((DemoFactory.Prototypes.BeastArena.Ui.BuildingMenu)f!.GetValue(Main)!).Close(); return "closed";

label: 点兽身开巨兽面板（走玩家那一条左键入口）
eval: var b = Main.World!.Voyage.Position; Main.CameraSetPose((float)b.X, (float)b.Z, 105f, 205f, 80f); var p = Main.Picker; string hit = ""; for (int y = 40; y < 1040 && hit == ""; y += 4) { for (int x = 40; x < 1880 && hit == ""; x += 4) { var r = p.Pick(new Godot.Vector2(x, y)); if (r.Target == DemoFactory.Prototypes.BeastArena.Ui.PickTarget.Beast) hit = x + "," + y; } } if (hit == "") throw new System.Exception("no-beast"); var parts = hit.Split(','); var mi = Main.GetType().GetMethod("OnWorldClicked", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance); mi!.Invoke(Main, new object[] { new Godot.Vector2(int.Parse(parts[0]), int.Parse(parts[1])) }); var bf = Main.GetType().GetField("_beastPanel", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance); var bp = (Godot.Control)bf!.GetValue(Main)!; if (!bp.Visible) throw new System.Exception("beast-panel-closed at " + hit); return "opened " + hit;

label: 等巨兽面板刷新
等面板重摆修理候选
魔晶「修理」那一颗：这一按就是 UseCrystal(repair) 动词
修理那一发成了
饭馆当场修满、仓库再扣 1 单位
eval: var w = Main.World!; if (w.Deck.IsRepairing("restaurant") || w.CrystalWarehouse != 1) throw new System.Exception("repairing=" + w.Deck.IsRepairing("restaurant") + " wh=" + w.CrystalWarehouse); return "repairing=0 wh=" + w.CrystalWarehouse;

label: 收起巨兽面板：经营弹层要能点得到
命令栏「经营」：开经营弹层（市场是第一栏）
等市场那一栏刷新
出售魔晶数量填 1
市场「出售魔晶」那一颗：这一按就是 SellCrystal 动词
出售那一发成了
仓库那一单位魔晶出库
eval: var w = Main.World!; if (w.CrystalWarehouse != 0) throw new System.Exception("wh=" + w.CrystalWarehouse); return "wh=" + w.CrystalWarehouse + " coin=" + w.Town.Coin;
